dataset.name: Primary breast cancer PAM50 cohort (SMC, 2018)
dataset.description: Independent Korean primary breast-cancer cohort with public TPM bulk RNA-seq and source-provided PAM50 subtype calls for expression comparison and GSEA.
dataset.cohort_context: Primary breast tumors from the Samsung Medical Center Korean cohort. The 168 TPM-profiled tumors carry source-provided PAM50 calls; these calls are preserved as metadata and are never silently recomputed by TRACE Explorer.

metadata.source_program: Samsung Medical Center breast cancer cohort
metadata.sample_selection_note: The cBioPortal TPM sample list contains 168 primary Tumor samples from 168 unique patients. Eligibility requires source SAMPLE_TYPE, SAMPLE_CLASS, ONCOTREE_CODE and PAM50_SUBTYPE values.
metadata.excluded_material: The 19 study tumors without TPM profiles and any future non-primary or non-tumor sample.
metadata.treatment_note: Primary tumor denotes specimen origin and does not by itself prove treatment-naive status.
metadata.subtype_note: PAM50_SUBTYPE is the source call. The source value Normal is a PAM50 Normal-like label within a primary tumor cohort, not adjacent normal tissue. Testing PAM50-defining genes across PAM50 groups is circular and must be labelled as descriptive rather than independent validation.
metadata.endpoint_note: No individual time-to-event endpoint is curated for this release. Survival, Compare-survival and Robustness-survival are prohibited even if a future upstream field appears without a new contract.

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same Entrez identifier are averaged sample-wise before transformation; different identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The public profile is RNA-seq TPM. TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) once and does not use the separate z-score profile as an expression layer.

prohibited.survival: No individual time-to-event endpoint is curated for BRCA SMC 2018; this cohort is restricted to molecular expression comparison and GSEA.
